preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, k must be even and both k and n must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters 0, 1, and ?.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if it is possible to make the bitstring k-balanced, otherwise output 'NO'.
